cleavage agent: proteins were digested with Trypsin/Lys-C (MS grade; Promega Corporation, Madison, WI)
collision energy: The top eight abundant peptide ions were chosen for fragmentation at 30% normalized collision energy

instrument: 1 μl for the supernatant samples and 10 μl of cytoplasmic and nuclear samples were injected into the Dionex UltiMate 3000 RSLCnano LC system coupled to the QExactive Orbitrap MS (all Thermo Fisher Scientific).
